items.title: BTS' Jin, Aespa's Ningning and Xiao Zhan Lead Gucci's Primavera Campaign
items.summary: Singapore fashion outlet covers Gucci's Primavera campaign under Demna, framing the K-pop/C-pop ambassador lineup (Jin, Ningning, Xiao Zhan) as most relevant to SEA's fandom-driven audience and describing the campaign's Renaissance-inspired theme of love, connection and reinvention.

items.title: Jin, Kate Moss, Shawn Mendes and More Star in Gucci's New Primavera Campaign
items.summary: Philippine edition covers the star-studded Primavera campaign directed by Johan Renck and shot by Michal Chelbin, noting the mix of global celebrities (Kate Moss, Shawn Mendes) alongside Asian ambassadors Jin and Xiao Zhan reaching local fashion audiences.

items.title: Gucci Reveals Primavera Campaign With Global Ambassador Lineup
items.summary: Thai edition of ELLE covers Gucci's Primavera campaign launch, listing the full ambassador roster (Kate Moss, Xiao Zhan, Jin, Ningning, Tom Brady, Shawn Mendes and others) and highlighting the Renaissance-art-inspired creative direction under Demna.

items.title: Series of Well-Known Shop Owners Prosecuted, Exposing Fake Gucci, Hermes Goods Sold on Shelves
items.summary: Vietnamese business outlet reports on a wave of prosecutions across Phu Tho, Can Tho, Ho Chi Minh City and Khanh Hoa where shop owners were charged for selling counterfeit Louis Vuitton, Dior, Gucci, Hermes and other luxury-branded goods, with over 23,000 fake items seized across the operations.

items.title: Prosecution Over Scheme Turning 1,000 Garments Into Fake Gucci, Dior Goods in Bac Ninh
items.summary: Bac Ninh police charged a man for operating a counterfeit-labeling operation that used heat presses and decal cutters to apply fake Gucci, Louis Vuitton, Dior, Lacoste, Nike, Adidas and Burberry labels onto blank garments, seizing over 1,000 items worth more than 200 million VND (~$8,000).

items.title: Thread explaining Gucci Jin (BTS) vs Xiao Zhan ambassador-treatment fan controversy
items.summary: Widely circulated X thread explains the fandom dispute after Gucci's Primavera campaign launch: some Jin (BTS) fans felt Xiao Zhan received better promotional treatment from Gucci, and the conflict escalated when a fan allegedly doxxed Xiao Zhan by posting his personal ID information, prompting legal action from the actor's studio. Content spread widely across Asian K-pop/C-pop fan communities including SEA-based fan accounts.

items.title: What happened between BTS' Jin and Xiao Zhan fans? Gucci comparisons escalate after alleged doxxing
items.summary: Fan-community aggregator site (drawing on Weibo/X/Xiaohongshu discourse) recaps the escalating Gucci ambassador fandom war between BTS Jin stans and Xiao Zhan fans, including counter-claims of doxxing on both sides circulating as of August 28; reflects active SNS/community chatter around the Gucci campaign across Asian fan bases including SEA K-pop communities.

items.title: From Bags to Shoes to Gucci Combs — Everything Gets Counterfeited
items.summary: Vietnamese secondhand/resale retailer blog discusses the proliferation of counterfeit Gucci goods down to small accessories like combs, reflecting consumer-side wariness and the resale/authentication conversation happening in Vietnam's luxury community around fake-goods enforcement news.
